Onchain options are no longer a one-venue market.

Notional volume more than doubled to $4.83B in September. Derive nearly kept pace and remains the clear leader. Its share of notional eased from 88.1% to 79.3% as two smaller venues grew even faster.

Hypercall and Paradex together held under 4% of the market in August. Hypercall went from $9.4M to $538.8M in a single month and now ranks second. Paradex nearly quadrupled after opening its request-for-quote system to the public.

Onchain options are starting to look like a competitive market.

Too many are over-reading this.

Confirming this, @AlexMalitas also noted that Ba spreads (blue repost) are not widening.
----
Which companies have people overreacting to CCC spread widening? 

* Acrisure LLC / Fin Inc: Insurance brokerage built through hundreds of agency acquisitions, expanding into fintech, payroll and cybersecurity services.

* Affinity Interactive: Formerly Affinity Gaming. Operates regional casinos, mostly in Nevada, plus properties in Missouri and Iowa.

* Altice Financing SA: Financing entity for Altice International, Patrick Drahi's telecom group outside the U.S. and France (Portugal, Israel, Dominican Republic).

* Aston Martin Capital Hldgs: Financing arm of Aston Martin Lagonda, the UK luxury sports car maker.

* Camelot Return Merger Sub: Acquisition vehicle Clayton, Dubilier & Rice used to take Cornerstone Building Brands private in 2022.

* Cornerstone Building: North American maker of exterior building products, including vinyl windows, siding, metal roofing and metal buildings.

* CSC Holdings LLC: Main operating and borrowing subsidiary of Altice USA, which sells cable, broadband and mobile service under the Optimum brand.

* Hertz Corp: Car rental through Hertz, Dollar and Thrifty.

* LBM Acquisition LLC: Issuer for US LBM, a Bain-backed distributor of lumber and building materials to homebuilders and contractors.

* LCPR Sr Secured Fin DAC: Financing vehicle for Liberty Latin America's cable, broadband and mobile operations in Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands.

* PM General Purchaser LLC: Vehicle KPS Capital Partners used to buy AM General, maker of the Humvee military vehicle.

* SC Games Holding / US Finco: Scientific Games, the Brookfield-owned lottery business that makes scratch-off tickets and runs state lottery systems.

* Signal Parent Inc: Parent of Interior Logic Group, which designs and installs flooring, cabinets and countertops for homebuilders.

* Tronox Inc: One of the world's largest producers of titanium dioxide, the white pigment used in paint, plastics, and paper.
